noWorkspace: No workspace open; cannot read hooks
trustFirst: Trust this hook before enabling it
sandboxNotice: Hooks can run outside of the sandbox, so review any recently installed or modified hooks
userNotice: User-level hooks apply to every project. There is no trust review — once enabled, they run directly.
deleteKeepScript: The hook entry will be removed from the configuration; the script file stays on disk.
rootDisabledNotice: Hook config is missing the root switch hooks.enabled:true — hooks stay inactive. Add it, then restart the IDE
revokeTitle: Revoking blocks the hook again; you can trust it again later
